corrections.text: The article states: "Liquipedia's match log records the forfeit result on July 15, 2026, at 13:00 CEST, with Vici Gaming winning by forfeit, according to Liquipedia." The Liquipedia Esports World Cup 2026 page, as archived, was last edited July 4, 2026 -- before the July 14-16 events described -- and its Survival Stage bracket shows the relevant July 15, 13:00 CEST slot as an unresolved 'TBD vs TBD' placeholder with no forfeit result recorded. The word "forfeit" does not appear on the page. The forfeit itself is real and separately confirmed by GosuGamers, which reported that "PlayTime have forfeited their match against Vici Gaming and have been eliminated from the tournament"; only the Liquipedia attribution for the specific time and result is incorrect.

The article attributes the quotes "No determination of misconduct has been made" and "ESIC's investigation remains ongoing" to Liquipedia's Esports World Cup 2026 tournament page. Neither phrase appears anywhere on that page. The underlying point -- that ESIC has made no determination of guilt and its investigation is ongoing -- is accurate and is independently confirmed by GosuGamers, which quotes ESIC's own statement that "no final determination of guilt has been made." The specific quotes attributed to Liquipedia were not found in the source and should not have been presented as an independent corroborating citation.
